extracted.name: Iced caramel macchiato
extracted.description: Take your coffee game up a notch this summer with our iced caramel macchiato – it's made with espresso, milk, vanilla syrup and caramel sauce
instruction_lines: Fill two tall glasses with ice and divide the milk and vanilla syrup between them before mixing well.
Pour an espresso shot into each glass, then drizzle with the caramel sauce before serving.
